notes.title: New Themes and Custom 3D Models!
notes.content:
Hello Golfers,

I am thrilled to announce the release of v0.8.0, a major update that brings exciting new features and improvements to Multiplayer Platform Golf!

This is a cool update featuring 11 brand new themes, giving the game a fresh and vibrant look. Explore these new themes and see how they transform the atmosphere of your levels.

Here is a demo of the new themes:
[previewyoutube=l2KCxA91EhA;full][/previewyoutube]

You can now import your custom 3D models into the level editor. This feature opens up endless possibilities for creativity, allowing you to design truly unique and personalized levels. You can import hundreds of thousands of models from Sketchfab or poly.pizza as GLB file format, or create your own custom models using free tools like Blender, Blockbench, or MagicaVoxel.

Here is a demo of importing custom 3D models:
[previewyoutube=8R9CsThBUOQ;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s been just over a month since I released the level editor, and I am blown away by the community’s response. Over 100 levels have been created and shared by players! I’ve had an absolute blast playing through these levels, and the creativity on display is incredible.

A heartfelt thank you to everyone who has shared feedback and reported bugs. Your input is invaluable and has played a crucial role in shaping the game. I couldn’t have reached this point without your support.

Changes:
- Add importing custom 3D models to level editor
- Add 11 new themes to level editor
- Add Featured Levels tab to highlight great community maps in lobby
- Add setting in Controls to disable Ball Cam when hitting the ball (you can still activate it manually)
- Add setting in Controls to disable Camera Smoothing
- Add stroke penalty when player kicks their own ball (with option to disable)
- Add button to reset player to start of hole for custom maps
- Update documentation and help window

Bugfixes:
- Fixed German localization from “Zurück zum Lobby” to “Zurück zur Lobby”
- Fixed bug in Spiky Hazard Links, Hole 8, where rotating timed spike platforms would drift
- Fixed broken mesh on platform between Hole 6 and 7 in Jumping Jamboree Junction
- Fixed bug where updated level name and description was not being saved locally (unless published)
- Fixed bug where you were able to select child objects rather than the entire hierarchy (for example flag poles)

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. I can’t wait to see what amazing levels you create with these new tools!

Happy golfing!

notes.title: NEW COURSE #10! v0.4.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm excited to announce Course #10, Fairway Friends Frenzy! This course is designed around teamwork and features the following new mechanics:
- Coop Platforms (all players must be on the platform to move)
- Flip Switches
- Targets
- Ball Bowl
- Rotating Lift Platform

Catch a glimpse of the new mechanics here:
[previewyoutube=mKsclwwKYyY;full][/previewyoutube]

I hope you enjoy!

Now that I've delivered 10 courses, up next is the level editor with Steam Workshop integration! I've already made good progress on the level editor earlier this year but wasn't able to get it ready in time for the release. I'm hoping to move fast and get it in player's hands as soon as possible. I also anticipate getting a lot of helpful feedback from the community. The goal is to make creating levels a fun experience by providing a streamlined UI/UX.

Thank you all for your continued support, feedback, and patience. Your input is immensely valued and essential to our progress.

Full Patch Notes:

    - Flip Switches!
    - Targets!
    - Rotating Lifts!
    - Ball Bowl!
- Add ball customization
- Add line indicator for last swing power
- Add Death count in scoreboard
- In Group Start mode add a penalty of 50 strokes if they don’t complete the course rather than setting it to 99
- Add localization to scoreboard
- Reduce volume of menu music
- Add arrow signs in Hole 3 in Jumping Jamboree Junction indicating you can bounce the ball off the purple curb
- Player Model in Main Menu will now change based on your customization

Bugfixes:

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I am thrilled to announce that my game will officially launch on February 29, 2024! The journey to this moment has been incredibly exciting, especially during the recent Steam Next Fest, which was a fantastic showcase of amazing demos and talented developers. I'm grateful to have been a part of it.

A heartfelt thank you to everyone who played the demo and added the game to their wishlist. Your enthusiasm fuels my passion and dedication. To the streamers who shared my game with the world, your support has been invaluable in spreading the word and building our community. And to my Discord members who provided insightful feedback, your contributions have been instrumental in refining the game experience.

As we approach the release date, here's what you can look forward to:

- An expanded universe with a total of 10 maps at launch, providing even more depth and challenges beyond the demo's 3.
- Numerous polishes and bug fixes to ensure smooth and enjoyable gameplay.
- A level editor, empowering you to create and share your own custom maps.

Your support and feedback have been the cornerstone of my development process. I'm dedicated to delivering a game that meets your expectations and provides a memorable experience.

Thank you for being on this journey with me. I can't wait for you to experience the full game on February 29!

Joseph

notes.title: Oh yeah I almost forgot the Demo is out. (also a trailer too)
notes.content:
I released the demo of Multiplayer Platform Golf a week or two ago and forgot to announce it here. So I'm announcing it now.

What's in the demo?
[list]
[*] Up to 12 player multiplayer.
[*] Three courses (9 holes each).
[*] Full gameplay (golfing and platforming).
[/list]

What's the difference between the demo and the main game?
[list]
[*] Demo has 3 courses, main game currently has 5. I'm going to add 5 more to the main game before release
[*] Main game will have a level editor and Steam workshop integration.
[*] Main game will get new course updates.
[/list]

Will the demo be updated?
Yes any bug fixes or mechanics updates will be updated in the demo.
Also I'll be adding a tutorial level that will be in the demo.

Why do the levels suck?
I've never designed a 3D platformer before so I'm learning. Hang tight there will be better levels coming from myself and the community once the level editor is out (assuming the game doesn't bomb on release).

tags.feature: Also I'll be adding a tutorial level that will be in the demo.
